en.summary: Despite the debug-style subject, this commit fixes real L1 flush and invalidate behavior; the cleanest isolated bug is the wrong encoding of the selected dirty way before tag/data lookup.
why_it_counts: The patch modifies active DCache, tag-access, and LSU RTL rather than debug-only code.
It corrects dirty-way selection and related flush sequencing in the L1 cache.
Using the wrong way encoding during writeback or invalidate directly affects cache correctness.
disqualifiers: The commit message is vague and the patch bundles several cache-control fixes together.
evidence: DCache.scala changes the flush/invalidate SRAM index from TagAccess.io.dirtyWayMask_st0.get to OHToUInt(TagAccess.io.dirtyWayMask_st0.get).
L1TagAccess.scala changes dirty tag selection from tagBodyAccess.io.r.resp.data(choosenDirtyWayMask_st0) to tagBodyAccess.io.r.resp.data(OHToUInt(choosenDirtyWayMask_st0)).
The same commit also tightens flush request issuance around invalidatenodirty, WSHR emptiness, and registered flush addresses.
LSU.scala adjusts the flush command handshake and flush parameter encoding.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: During a cache flush or invalidate, the controller finds a dirty way and then reads the corresponding per-way tag/data state. The bug is to treat the selected one-hot way mask as if it were already a binary way index. On a multi-way cache, that can make the maintenance path read or write the wrong way, so the wrong line is written back or invalidated while the actual dirty line remains behind.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush or invalidate walks a set that contains at least one dirty way in a multi-way cache.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Use the raw one-hot way mask directly at the point where the design expects a binary way index.
portability_notes: This maps to any set-associative cache whose victim or dirty-way chooser produces a one-hot result.
If another DUT uses mux trees instead of SRAM indexing, the equivalent mutation is to drive the per-way selector with the wrong encoding.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the flush or eviction path that selects a dirty or victim way.
At the tag or data lookup point, remove the onehot-to-binary conversion and feed the raw one-hot selection into the index or equivalent selector.
Keep the rest of the flush request path unchanged so the injected fault isolates way selection rather than request generation.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L1 dirty-way lookup for flush and invalidate
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit converts dirty-way one-hot masks to OHToUInt before indexing tag and data structures, fixing wrong-way selection during cache maintenance.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In DCache.scala the flush/read SRAM setIdx concatenation changed to use OHToUInt(TagAccess.io.dirtyWayMask_st0.get), and in L1TagAccess.scala dirty tag selection changed to use OHToUInt(choosenDirtyWayMask_st0).

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Flush or invalidate may act on the wrong cache way, leaving a real dirty line resident or writing back incorrect data, which can later surface as stale or corrupted memory contents.
evidence_for_injection: Both touched files independently replace one-hot way usage with OHToUInt conversion in the maintenance path.
The changed logic is specifically under dirty-line discovery and flush handling, not under debug output.
The rest of the commit shows surrounding flush-control fixes, confirming that the bug sits in active maintenance logic.
notes: This is the cleanest single reinjection point from an otherwise multi-fix cache-control commit.
The LSU-side flush-command changes are real but less portable than the way-selection bug.

zh.summary: 虽然提交标题带有 debug 色彩，但该提交修复了真实的 L1 flush/invalidate 行为；其中最适合单独回注的故障是：在查找脏路对应 tag/data 之前，错误地使用了路选择编码。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是实际生效的 DCache、tag-access 和 LSU RTL，而不是纯调试代码。
它修正了 L1 cache 中 dirty-way 的选择以及相关 flush 时序。
在写回或 invalidate 时使用错误的路编码会直接破坏 cache 正确性。
disqualifiers: 提交信息比较模糊，而且同一补丁中混入了多个 cache 控制修复。
evidence: DCache.scala 把 flush/invalidate 的 SRAM 索引从 TagAccess.io.dirtyWayMask_st0.get 改成了 OHToUInt(TagAccess.io.dirtyWayMask_st0.get)。
L1TagAccess.scala 把脏 tag 选择从 tagBodyAccess.io.r.resp.data(choosenDirtyWayMask_st0) 改成了 tagBodyAccess.io.r.resp.data(OHToUInt(choosenDirtyWayMask_st0))。
同一提交还收紧了 invalidatenodirty、WSHR empty 和寄存后的 flush 地址等相关控制。
LSU.scala 还调整了 flush 命令握手和 flush 参数编码。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 cache 执行 flush 或 invalidate 时，控制器会先找出一个脏路，然后读取对应路的 tag/data 状态。这个缺陷的本质是：把 one-hot 路掩码当成二进制路索引直接使用。对于多路组相联 cache，这会让维护路径访问错误的 way，从而写回或失效错误的 cache line，而真正的脏 line 仍然残留。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache 维护路径中的 dirty-way 选择
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 在多路组相联 cache 中，flush 或 invalidate 遍历到了至少包含一条脏路的 set。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在设计本来期望二进制 way 索引的位置，直接使用原始 one-hot 路选择结果。
portability_notes: 该模式适用于任何用 one-hot 结果表示 victim/dirty way 的组相联 cache。
如果另一套 DUT 使用 mux 树而不是 SRAM 索引，对应的等效注入就是让每路选择信号使用错误编码。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 flush 或 eviction 路径中选择脏路或 victim 路的逻辑。
在读取 tag 或 data 的位置，去掉 one-hot 到二进制的转换，直接把原始 one-hot 结果送入索引或等价选择器。
保持其余 flush 请求路径不变，使注入故障只体现为 way 选择错误，而不是请求生成错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L1 flush/invalidate 的 dirty-way 查找路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交在 tag/data 结构索引前把 dirty-way 的 one-hot 掩码转换为 OHToUInt，修复了 cache 维护时选错路的问题。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: DCache.scala 中 flush/read 的 SRAM setIdx 拼接改为使用 OHToUInt(TagAccess.io.dirtyWayMask_st0.get)；L1TagAccess.scala 中脏 tag 选择也改为使用 OHToUInt(choosenDirtyWayMask_st0)。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: flush 或 invalidate 可能对错误的 cache 路生效，导致真实脏 line 未被清走，或把错误数据写回内存，后续表现为陈旧数据或数据破坏。
evidence_for_injection: 两个被修改文件都在维护路径里把 one-hot 路选择改成了 OHToUInt 转换。
这些改动明确位于脏行发现和 flush 处理路径，而不是调试输出路径。
同一提交中的其他修改也都围绕 flush 控制，说明该缺陷属于真实维护逻辑错误。
notes: 在这个多修复提交里，这是最容易稳定回注的单点故障。
LSU 侧的 flush 命令修复也是真实问题，但可移植性不如这个 way 选择错误。
